usage.costBasis: CLI-reported list-price estimate (total_cost_usd), cumulative per session; not provider-billed
usage.finalMessage:
Invoices now take off the premium discount (DEC-B06, 5%) and the nonprofit discount (DEC-B07, 10%). `show`, balances and late fees use the discounted amount, and `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes (11 tests, 3 of them new).
One case is not done: no decision record says how the two discounts combine for a customer who is both premium and nonprofit (e.g. c4). For now `invoice` refuses these customers with an `error:` line, where it used to bill them at full price. Finance needs to decide the rule.
The changes and `.work/report.json` are committed.
OUTCOME: completed
